text: High-performance control for modern, data-aware machines

How quickly can my team design, deploy and support this system? How do I reduce cabinet size while maintaining performance? How can I standardize on one control system across a wide range of machines without overengineering? How can I provide secure access to machine data without affecting control performance?
heading: High-performance control for modern, data-aware machines

text: These are the difficult questions manufacturers and machine builders must answer when designing and commissioning control platforms across industries where performance remains a priority while safety and security standards continue to evolve. The CompactLogix® 5390 Controller makes this process simple by delivering high performance in a compact, secure architecture. With local PointMax™ I/O and a simplified system structure, this control platform is built to handle data-intensive workloads while streamlining machine design and installation empowering you to build smarter, safer and more flexible automation systems.
heading: High-performance control for modern, data-aware machines

text: Control that scales with your machine

When you need a control and information platform that balances performance, scalability and flexibility for a wide variety of industrial applications, look no further than the CompactLogix 5390 Controller. With high-performance processing for faster scan times, scalable memory and I/O capacity, integrated motion and safety and the ability to handle high-density I/O and large tag databases, this controller gives you the flexibility and power needed to support your evolving machine designs.

heading: Control that scales with your machine

text: CompactLogix 5390 Controllers are part of a broader ecosystem that supports a cohesive automation infrastructure, from device-level control to enterprise connection. By standardizing on Logix, you can simplify development, optimize performance and enable modular, future-ready systems using a consistent software toolset.
heading: A connected control foundation

text: Integration with PointMax I/O for both local and remote I/O support gives you the design flexibility to create unified architectures from small machines in space-constrained environments to large systems requiring additional support.
heading: A connected control foundation

text: A scalable foundation for modern machines

CompactLogix 5390 Controllers support demanding applications with integrated motion, safety and cybersecurity, along with advanced communication capabilities. With support for up to 128 motion axes and 4000 OPC UA nodes, it is built to handle high-speed, data-intensive operations.
heading: Performance for Complex Applications

text: CompactLogix 5390 Controllers help support global security standards with compliance to IEC 62443-4-2, the Cyber Resiliency Act (CRA) and built-in technologies like CIP Security and Syslog. These capabilities help protect systems while enabling more secure connectivity.
heading: Meets Global Cybersecurity Requirements

text: With OPC UA and high-speed network support including Dual IP, DLR, Star and Linear topologies, CompactLogix 5390 Controllers enable clear data access across operations, giving you the visibility needed to make more informed production decisions.
heading: Data-driven Decision-making

text: A modular architecture supporting up to 32 PointMax™ I/O modules allows for flexible system expansion and consistent design across machine families. Simplified integration and configuration further reduce engineering effort while maintaining a scalable control platform.
heading: Modular Design

text: By reducing SKUs, simplifying procurement and allowing for a more streamlined design approach, CompactLogix 5390 Controllers help reduce operational and engineering complexity, resulting in lower design costs.
heading: Architectural Simplification

text: Designed with sustainability in mind, CompactLogix 5390 Controllers incorporate recycled materials, reduce power consumption and support a lower carbon footprint. They also enable smarter resource utilization across the machine lifecycle.
heading: More Sustainable Operations
